audience.public_segment: South African NGO, NPO, M&E, grant and programme teams
audience.internal_buyer_unit: M&E/Impact; Grants/Donor Reporting; Programme Director/COO; Finance/Compliance; Knowledge Management

hypothesis: If NASCEE is shown 'Golden Evidex transaction: source intake -> evidence pack -> human approval -> payment/delivery receipt with provenance.', then the M&E/grants/compliance decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

experiment.channel: Current organisational route + LinkedIn thought-leadership/proof case + permission-safe pilot invitation
experiment.proof_summary: A controlled messy-input-to-evidence-pack case with mapped claims, provenance, human review, delivery state and business telemetry.
experiment.public_hook: Your funder wants proof. The proof is spread across folders, spreadsheets and email. Evidex turns that evidence mess into a review-ready pack.
experiment.cta: Review the golden case and nominate one bounded evidence-pack pilot.
experiment.kill_condition: No qualified engagement after two permission-safe attempts or channel test; re-evaluate message/fit before any further approach.

gates.reason: Research and proof-content generation are allowed; no valid electronic sales permission is recorded.
